pages.title: About
pages.markdown:
## Our story

Your Brand began as two designers and an engineer sharing a table. We kept being asked to fix products that had been designed by one team and built by another, so we started a studio where both sit together from the first sketch.

## How we work

Every project has a designer and an engineer on it from the first day, and a client who comes to the Friday review. We show working things, not decks.

## Life here

We are fourteen people in one room. Lunch is shared, critiques are kind and the plants are real.
